name: Jonathan White
source: Elegant, charming, handsome, and a snob. Being the heir to a global phone company,money has never been a problem for Jonathan, neither has been grades or winning favors. Despite so he is powerless, his family conceals it by making skin tight, see through gloves that emit fire, making it seem like Jonathan can control fire, when actually the only thing mutant about him is his maybe too stunning blue eyes. Despite his wealth and popularity, he has a very prominent inferiority complex towards his younger-genius-brother, Felix.
